items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I was working with Kai Winding. And some other friends of ours, Johnny Mesa and Carl Fontana.

ctx.x: Why are you playing that when you could play a sax? I don’t understand. What was your first like memorable playing experience, either big band or combo or what you would consider to be your real start. I know you did Kai Winding.
Yeah, I was with his group early, I was in my late teens. I think I was 19 years old and I was working with Kai Winding. And some other friends of ours, Johnny Mesa and Carl Fontana.
Oh, yeah, that was a nice group. Four trombones and rhythm. Great.
